resolution.question: Will flatmates Dana and Yusuf agree on a cleaning rota that both explicitly sign off on in their flat group chat before Sunday night?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that both Dana and Yusuf have explicitly sent messages in the group chat indicating their agreement (e.g., 'I agree', 'Signed off', or similar) before the cutoff time. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
